workflows.name: Feature Build
workflows.description: Plan, implement, verify, test, and review a production-quality feature.
workflows.template: Build this feature professionally: {{goal}}. Inspect the existing project first, minimize regressions, implement cleanly, run available tests, repair failures, and verify acceptance criteria.

workflows.name: Bug Repair
workflows.description: Diagnose a defect, identify root cause, repair it, and add verification evidence.
workflows.template: Diagnose and repair this issue: {{goal}}. Reproduce or identify the root cause, make the smallest reliable fix, test it, check for regressions, and document the evidence.

workflows.name: Project Audit
workflows.description: Review architecture, reliability, security boundaries, maintainability, and test health.
workflows.template: Audit this project with professional rigor: {{goal}}. Inspect architecture, risks, maintainability, performance, test health, and operational gaps. Make only clearly justified low-risk fixes unless broader changes are explicitly requested.

workflows.name: Research & Report
workflows.description: Research using available local knowledge and approved web access, then produce a structured report.
workflows.template: Research and produce a decision-ready report on: {{goal}}. Distinguish evidence from assumptions, use available project knowledge, use web access only if enabled, and save the finished report in the workspace.

workflows.name: Release Readiness
workflows.description: Run a release-focused verification, repair bounded failures, and report go/no-go evidence.
workflows.template: Assess release readiness for: {{goal}}. Map the project, run available build/test/check scripts, diagnose and repair bounded failures, review changed files and unresolved risks, and produce a final release-readiness report.
